paper_title: Dark Matter Search with a Resonantly-Coupled Hybrid Spin System
coupling_convention: canonical g_ann, dimensionless (plotted as g_ann in GeV^-1 axis but is dimensionless neutron coupling)
notes: Paper constrains both axion-neutron (gann) and axion-proton (gapp) couplings using K-Rb-21Ne hybrid spin system, covering Compton frequency [0.01,1000] Hz (ma ~ 4e-17 to 4e-12 eV). The coupling is quoted in GeV^-1 (nonstandard dimensionful convention for g_aNN gradient coupling). The main quoted sensitivity: |gann| <= 3e-10 GeV^-1 in [2e-2,4] Hz; and about 3e-9 GeV^-1 for fa in [3,30] Hz. Full limit data is tabulated in a supplementary reference [38] not present in the text, so only approximate representative points from text are given. Data points here use frequency-to-mass conversion (m=4.136e-15*f): representative flat-ish region ~3e-9 GeV^-1 near f~2-100 Hz. AxionNeutron chosen (primary result) though gapp also reported.
